code: library(shiny)  # -- on UI side actionButton(inputId = "btn_1", label = "Do this with row 1") actionButton(inputId = "btn_2", label = "Do this with row 2")   # -- on Server side observeEvent(input$btn_1, {   # do something with row 1 })   observeEvent(input$btn_2, {   # do something with row 2 }) actionButton(inputId = "btn_1",               label = "Do this with row 1",              onClick = paste0('Shiny.setInputValue(\"action\", 1, {priority: \"event\"})'))  actionButton(inputId = "btn_2",               label = "Do this with row 1",              onClick = paste0('Shiny.setInputValue(\"action\", 2, {priority: \"event\"})'))   observeEvent(input$action, {      # -- perform action of specific row   target_row <- input$action    })

title: Building vectorized Shiny UI / Server actions
text: reduce amount redundant code write & avoid mistakes, ktools provides 3 functions support pattern: onclick_event() action_link() input_decode() first one helps building onClick event instruction, including namespace working Shiny modules. ’s called inside action_link() function used example tune actionButton. action_link() function vectorized wrapper around Shiny::actionLink() function also includes namespace capabilities. last one meant decode specific pattern can used inputId(s) actionLinks HTML tags, can sent observer decode source (namespace), action value (probably row id apply action).

title: Building vectorized Shiny UI / Server actions
text: said earlier, motivation generated many similar actions target vectorized / row-wise data. Let’s create basic dataset: , want create actionLink row data.frame: generate list actionLink components unique id(s) based default pattern: "action_link_1", "action_link_2", … clicked, links trigger input$on_click, passing component’s id. One can decide make component id(s) explicit using pattern argument: time, input$on_click receive custom tag id "do_this_1", "do_this_2", … opens using input entry manage multiple actions inside observer / listener. input_decode() function assist: returns named vector shape c(namespace, action, value) c(action, value) namespace used identify source action, action ’s target (value row id). listener / observer look like : extension, unique observeEvent used trigger various actions like add subtract 1 quantity set zero.
code: df <- data.frame(id = 1:10,                  value = runif(10)) library(ktools)  # -- Send default tag id to the target input: links <- action_link(id = df$id, label = "click", target = "on_click") # -- Send custom tag id to the target input:  action_link(id = df$id, label = "click", target = "on_click", pattern = "do_this") input_decode("do_this_1") observeEvent(input$on_click, {      # -- decode input value   event <- input_decode(input$on_click)      # -- do something on target row (here set it's 'value' column to 1)   if(event$action == "do_this")     df[df$id == event$value, ]$value <- 1    })
